title_zh: 约定私下了解种族偏见报告的处理流程

scenario.label_zh: 约定私下了解种族偏见报告流程
scenario.goal_zh: 说明种族偏见言论及隐私顾虑，约定私下了解处理流程与信息使用方式后再决定分享内容

context_zh: 社团成员向负责人报告上次活动中发生的不当言论。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: Someone made a racist remark about my family at the last meeting. I don't want to repeat it in front of the whole group.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: You don't have to. We can talk privately and record what happened in your own words.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: They said I shouldn't be so sensitive about my racial background.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: That doesn't make the comment acceptable. Our rules against racism apply to how members treat each other, not just to public posts.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: I'm willing to explain what happened, but I want to know who will see the report.

sentences.speaker: Gareth
sentences.text: Let's meet in the office after this session. I'll explain the process and how the information would be used before you decide what to share.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: All right. I'll come then, and we can start with that explanation.

targets.sense_zh: 种族主义的或带有种族偏见的
